source: OpenCode Zen documentation + provider privacy policies

1_strict.label: Strict Privacy
1_strict.description: No data used for training. Zero-retention. No logging for improvement.

2_anonymous_improvement.label: Anonymous Improvement Only
2_anonymous_improvement.description: Data may be logged for service improvement but NOT linked to your identity. No model training.

3_model_improvement.label: Model Improvement
3_model_improvement.description: Data may be used to improve the model during the free period. Not linked to identity.

4_explicit_training.label: Explicit Training
4_explicit_training.description: Data is explicitly used to train future models. You consent to this by using the service.

opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra Free
opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free.evidence: Trial use only. Logged for improvement but not linked to identity. NVIDIA states: 'not designed to derive insights from personal data'.

opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free
opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free.evidence: Trial use only. Logged for improvement but not linked to identity. NVIDIA states: 'not designed to derive insights from personal data'.

opencode/mimo-v2.5-free.name: MiMo-V2.5 Free
opencode/mimo-v2.5-free.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.' Xiaomi direct API says 'won't use without consent' but Zen free tier has no opt-out.

opencode/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free.name: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin Free
opencode/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.' Alibaba direct says 'never use for training' but Zen intermediary policy applies.

opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash Free
opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free.evidence: DeepSeek privacy policy: 'We may use your Inputs and Outputs to train and improve our models and services.' Opt-out available via settings on direct API, but unclear on Zen free tier.

opencode/big-pickle.name: Big Pickle
opencode/big-pickle.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.' Unknown provider, unknown direct policy.

opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free
opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'Heavily discounted token pricing in exchange for permission to use your prompts and completions to train future Meta models.' EXPLICIT consent to train Meta models.

opencode/jev-1.13-free.name: JEV 1.13 Free
opencode/jev-1.13-free.evidence: No explicit privacy policy found. Assumed same as other Zen free models during free period.
